legal.case_number.description: A unique identifier for each legal case. Format: integer count
legal.case_number.meaning: A unique identifier for each legal case.

legal.case_type.description: The case_type column categorizes legal cases into specific types such as 'Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', and 'Commercial Case', with all other cases falling under 'Other'. Format: one of the compared labels: 'Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case', 'Other'. If the document does not mention it: Other
legal.case_type.format: one of the compared labels: 'Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case', 'Other'
legal.case_type.meaning: The case_type column categorizes legal cases into specific types such as 'Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', and 'Commercial Case', with all other cases falling under 'Other'.

legal.defendant_current_status.description: Indicates the current status of the defendant, which can be 'Government', 'Company', or 'Organization', or any other status. Format: one of the compared labels (Government, Company, Organization, Other). If the document does not mention it: Other
legal.defendant_current_status.format: one of the compared labels (Government, Company, Organization, Other)
legal.defendant_current_status.meaning: Indicates the current status of the defendant, which can be 'Government', 'Company', or 'Organization', or any other status.

legal.evidence.description: A description of evidence admissible or inadmissible in court cases, including details on its relevance and impact. Format: free text. If the document does not mention it: null
legal.evidence.meaning: A description of evidence admissible or inadmissible in court cases, including details on its relevance and impact.

legal.first_judge.description: The name of the first judge who presided over the case as mentioned in the judgment document. Format: free text
legal.first_judge.meaning: The name of the first judge who presided over the case as mentioned in the judgment document.

legal.hearing_year.description: The year in which the legal hearing took place. Format: four-digit year. If the document does not mention it: null
legal.hearing_year.meaning: The year in which the legal hearing took place.

legal.judge_name.description: The name of the judge who presided over the case as mentioned in the document. Format: one of the compared labels
legal.judge_name.meaning: The name of the judge who presided over the case as mentioned in the document.

legal.judgment_year.description: The year in which the legal judgment was made. Format: four-digit year. If the document does not mention it: null
legal.judgment_year.meaning: The year in which the legal judgment was made

legal.legal_basis_num.description: The number of legal statutes or references cited in the case. Format: integer count. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.legal_basis_num.meaning: The number of legal statutes or references cited in the case.

legal.nationality_for_applicant.description: The nationality of the applicant, categorized as one of 'Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh', or 'Other'. Format: one of 'Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh', 'Other'. If the document does not mention it: Other
legal.nationality_for_applicant.meaning: The nationality of the applicant, categorized as one of 'Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh', or 'Other'.

legal.plaintiff_current_status.description: Indicates whether the plaintiff is an individual or a company, organization, or government entity. Format: one of the compared labels (Company, Organization, Government, Individual_or_other). If the document does not mention it: Individual_or_other
legal.plaintiff_current_status.format: one of the compared labels (Company, Organization, Government, Individual_or_other)
legal.plaintiff_current_status.meaning: Indicates whether the plaintiff is an individual or a company, organization, or government entity.

legal.verdict.description: The final decision or ruling made in a legal case, categorized into specific labels or grouped into broader categories. Format: one of the compared labels: 'Approved', 'Dismissed', 'Others', or 'Other'. If the document does not mention it: Other
legal.verdict.format: one of the compared labels: 'Approved', 'Dismissed', 'Others', or 'Other'
legal.verdict.meaning: The final decision or ruling made in a legal case, categorized into specific labels or grouped into broader categories.
